name: axs15231b
title: AXS15231B
notes: A controller of a display and of its touch in one chip: the display on QSPI, the touch on I2C. A board names it twice, a device of each class, and gives each its own config.

facts.source: esp32-component-dgx, include/drivers/axs15231b.h and CHANGES 0.12.7: the display on QSPI, tried on the Guition JC3248W535; the touch answered at 0x3B on that board, 2026-11-27
